note.note:
Please provide the actual content for:
- Transcript (the doctor–patient dialogue)
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON

Once I have those, I will produce a structured "Problem List Clinical Note" with:
- Consult Summary: two-line overview
- Problem List (Issue 1–3), each including timeline, symptoms, systems review, social history, meds, exam findings, and differential diagnoses drawn from the DDx (only if consistent with the transcript, with likelihood tags and one-line justification)
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality Checks (missing elements, conflicts, and transcript quality notes)

Notes:
- I will not invent data not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name with “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON here.
